name: A New Plague
label: Quest
description: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan studies how an ancient plague survived in spider venom. He seeks a potent new biological agent for the Forsaken.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan studies how an ancient plague survived in spider venom. He seeks a potent new biological agent for the Forsaken.

Apothecary Johaan studies old texts in Brill for the Royal Apothecary Society. He finds records of an ancient pestilence that killed thousands. The texts say the pathogen survived across generations in the venom of Tirisfal Glades' local spiders. Johaan needs that venom as a biological reagent.

Apothecary Johaan sends agents to eastern Tirisfal Glades for a viable sample. Venomweb Vale lies south of the Scarlet Monastery, where vicious night web spiders infest the hollow. Harvesters must enter their dens and gather fresh venom glands for Johaan's experimental brew.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims. Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment. I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction. Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, friend? It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, friend. Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down. Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
